title: Diwali Party Outfits for the Office: Easy Looks for the USA and UK
excerpt: Office Diwali party in the USA or UK? Here is what to wear: polished kurta sets, smart tunic looks and styling tips that fit a workplace celebration.
body:
For an office Diwali party abroad, wear a polished embroidered kurta set or a smart tunic with tailored trousers: festive enough to celebrate, neat enough that you can walk back to your desk afterwards. Choose rich colours, keep the embroidery tasteful and save the heavy lehenga for the family function.

## Read the room before you dress

Office Diwali events in the USA, UK and Canada come in many forms. Some are a lunchtime potluck in the break room, some are an after-work gathering with snacks and a short talk about the festival, and some are a full evening event organised by an employee network. Each one asks for a slightly different level of sparkle.

A quick guide:

| Type of event | What to wear | What to skip |
|---|---|---|
| Lunchtime potluck at work | Embroidered tunic with trousers or jeans | Heavy dupatta, long trail |
| After-work drinks and snacks | Cotton kurta set with light embroidery | Very sheer fabrics |
| Evening event hosted by the company | Sequin or gota detail kurta set, statement earrings | Full bridal jewellery |
| Client-facing office day | Tunic under a blazer | Loud prints with loud jewellery |

If you are unsure, ask the organiser. Many colleagues who are not Indian will be excited to wear something festive too, so your outfit may even help them choose.

## The kurta set: your safest office hero

A three-piece kurta set with straight pants is the easiest office Diwali outfit. It looks smart, moves well and covers all the bases for a mixed audience.

The [Violet Nyra Cut Sequin Embroidered Cotton Suit Set](/products/violet-nyra-cut-sequin-embroidered-cotton-3-piece-suit/) is a strong pick here. The Nyra cut flares gently from the waist so it looks elegant without being dramatic, the cotton is comfortable through a full workday, and the sequins add just enough shimmer under office lighting.

Deep jewel tones such as violet, plum, wine and bottle green look polished in a work setting and pair well with a black or camel coat for the commute. The [Plum Purple Embroidered Cotton Suit Set](/products/plum-purple-embroidered-cotton-3-piece-suit/), with its pink rose embroidery on the yoke, is festive yet grown-up.

Wear the dupatta folded neatly over one shoulder, or pin it in place so it does not slip while you serve food or hold a plate.

## The tunic look: festive with a work twist

If your office is strict about dress code, or the party is at lunch, a short kurti or tunic is the smartest move. Wear it over slim black trousers, a straight skirt or dark jeans if your office allows denim.

The [Wine Brown Embroidered Cotton Tunic Top](/products/wine-brown-embroidered-cotton-tunic-top/) works beautifully under an open blazer, with small gold hoops and loafers. Remove the blazer for the party, add jhumkas, and the look turns festive in seconds.

For a lighter, block printed option, the [Aqua Leaf Hand Block Print Cotton Pintuck Tunic Top](/products/aqua-leaf-hand-block-print-cotton-pintuck-tunic-top/) is hand printed by karigars in our Jaipur unit. Fine pintucks keep it neat and structured.

Browse more short styles in our [tunic tops](/cotton-tunic-tops-short-kurtis-for-jeans/) collection.

## Weather, coats and commuting

Early November in London, New York or Toronto can be cold and wet. Plan your outfit around the commute as well as the party.

- Choose cotton or cotton blends that do not crease badly under a coat.
- Ankle-length pants are better than wide palazzos on rainy streets.
- A long wool coat in black, camel or grey looks smart over any kurta set.
- Carry juttis or embellished flats in your bag and wear boots on the way.
- Keep a small pouch with earrings and a lipstick so you can switch from work mode to party mode in the bathroom mirror.

## Jewellery and grooming: less but better

In an office, one statement piece works better than many. Pick either bold earrings or a necklace, not both. Jhumkas, chandbalis or oxidised silver studs all suit a kurta set.

A small bindi, a stack of three or four thin bangles and neatly tied hair finish the look. If the event has a henna stall, a simple design on one hand looks lovely and does not distract in meetings the next day.

## Getting the fit right from abroad

An office outfit should look sharp, and sharp means good fit at the shoulder and bust. Off-the-rack ethnic wear rarely fits perfectly, and local alterations can be costly.

You can share your bust, waist, hip and height and we stitch your set to measure at no extra cost, then send photos of the piece being made before it ships. Shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE and Australia is free and tracked. Diwali falls on 8 November 2026, and many office events happen in the week before or after, so order a little early.

## Frequently asked questions

**Is it appropriate to wear a kurta set to an office Diwali party?**
Yes. A kurta set is one of the most suitable options. Choose one with tasteful embroidery and a neat dupatta drape.

**What can I wear if I want to look festive but stay professional?**
An embroidered tunic with tailored trousers and a blazer is a safe, smart choice. Remove the blazer and add earrings for the party.

**What colours look best for an office Diwali party?**
Jewel tones such as violet, plum, wine, royal blue and bottle green look festive and polished in a work setting.

**Can my non-Indian colleagues wear Indian clothes to the party?**
Many do, and it is usually welcomed. A simple kurta or tunic is an easy and respectful choice.
